description: "Apply the default recipe (WebP textures <=2048px, quantized geometry, lossless cleanup), with any lever overridden by flags. Several inputs or a directory need -o <dir/>."
flags[11]: "--texture-format keep|webp|avif|jpeg|png|ktx2 (default webp)","--texture-quality 1-100 for color maps (default 90)","--texture-data-quality 1-100 for normal, metal/rough and occlusion maps (default: max(--texture-quality, 95))","--texture-size <px> max texture side (default 2048)","--ktx2 etc1s|uastc|etc1s+uastc (color+data modes when --texture-format ktx2; default etc1s+uastc)","--geometry quantize|meshopt|draco|none (default quantize)","--simplify <ratio> keep this share of triangles, 0.05-1 (default 1)","--meshopt-level medium|high","--draco-bits P,N,T quantization bits for positions, normals, texcoords (default 14,10,12)","--keep-hierarchy  do not flatten or instance nodes","-f, --force  replace existing outputs"
